articles.summary: Kinetik Holdings Inc. (NYSE: KNTK) (“ Kinetik ” or the “ Company ”) today reported financial and operating results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Kinetik reported net income including noncontrolling interest of $50.9 million and $168.9 million for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, respectively. Kinetik generated Adjusted EBITDA 1 of $278.1 million and $810.1 million, Distributable Cash Flow 1 of $213.7 million and $589.5 million, and Free Cash Flow 1 of $87.5 million and $294.1 million for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, respectively. Highlights Record processed gas volumes of 1.94 Bcf/d Upsized Kings Landing II processing capacity by more than 25% to 380 MMcf/d Reached final investment decision on phase 1 of the ECCC Pipeline expansion, which is expected to increase throughput capacity by roughly 50% to approximately 225 MMcf/d Ordered long-lead equipment for the Company's next processing expansion beyond Kings Landing II Executed new
articles.title: Kinetik Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
